findings.finding: All thirty final original PNGs show a complete card with readable header, six prayer rows, date/footer, a largely in-frame textured gibbous Moon and surrounding stars. No obvious phase, material, scale or coverage swap was seen in these named final stills. The matching final snapshots report Moon ready/current/refined-terrain, sky ready, and a visible 325x530 card.
findings.limits: This is isolated final-state evidence; it is not a continuous visual, all-phase opacity, first-scene or scientific H1 approval.

findings.finding: The receipt-selected original Firefox direct constrained cold/warm and iframe constrained warm samples contain truncation or a pale band over lower prayer content. Adjacent originals confirm the interruptions are present in retained source images.
findings.limits: Cause is unresolved. Do not call this proven widget scaling/layout failure, dismiss it as a recorder defect, or repair it with later healthy PNGs. No S1 or continuous S4 credit.

findings.finding: The -00 PNG in every run is requested at 15000 ms, not startup zero. At that snapshot all thirty sky states are ready, but twenty-six Moon states remain refining/terrain-preview; four Chromium snapshots are already ready/refined. Later final records are all ready/refined.
findings.limits: A visible Moon at fifteen seconds does not imply refinement completed then, nor prove the transition into final quality was continuous.

findings.finding: The exact ten combinations cover file and direct entry at desktop1100x900/DPR2 and constrained375x800/DPR1, plus generic iframe at constrained375x800/DPR1, on Chromium and Firefox; each includes cold, warm reload and new tab.
findings.limits: This is not the full viewport/DPR/entry Cartesian matrix. The generic harness iframe is 330x534, while its inner product card is325x530; it is not the production builder/copy snippet/preset wrapper geometry or an actual extension parent. File entry targets index.html, not offline.html or offline-network recovery.

findings.finding: Snapshot source uses finite provider redirection, a real-rate shifted Date origin, motion=full and an exterior timer; it does not enable renderer wrappers, CPU profiles or tracing for these runs. Final native identity is the same Orlando wall-clock scene, generation0.
findings.limits: No settings/seek/profile/recovery/layer interventions were requested here. No M0 continuous watch or public-provider truth claim. The file/browser/platform/fixture identities are those of the retained runs.

findings.finding: Prior Firefox iframe DPR2 new-tab quality failure, original blank/truncated/white-band records, source-clock limitations, actual-parent limits, strict timing failures and incomplete cost findings remain unchanged.
findings.limits: No full S7, S1, continuous S4, release or closure PASS is granted by this return.

pixelReviewMethod.selection: All thirty final PNGs plus the cold -00 PNG for each case. One native JPEG per entry run selected as the first source receipt at or after navigationAbsolute+1200ms; six adjacent originals inspected for the three contrary samples.
pixelReviewMethod.rawTimeLimits: Receipt-relative selection is not calibrated presentation time or a first-visible search. Chromium and Firefox sourceTimeSeconds have different clock domains; no absolute timestamp conversion is inferred here.
pixelReviewMethod.streamOwnership: Cold and warm reload share one retained source/video stream per case; new tab has another. Samples are selected against each run navigationAbsolute, excluding pre-navigation frames for the chosen target.
pixelReviewMethod.pixelDimensions: Original PNGs are375x800 or2200x1800; the view tool displayed desktop PNGs at1759x1440. Sampled source JPEGs are374x798 in constrained Chromium,374x797 in constrained Firefox, and1100x900 in desktop runs. Their source extent is retained; no DPR-pixel equivalence or image repair is inferred.
pixelReviewMethod.compressionAndSamplingLimits: Original JPEG compression, requested recording dimensions and sparse inspection limit pixel-level/continuous claims. The encoded25fps video is not treated as proof of native source cadence.
